text.p: Integon Corp said Monday that it will retain Goldman, Sachs & Co to review strategic alternatives, including the sale of the company.
Integon reported a first quarter operating loss of $2.19 a share, compared with a profit of $0.04 a share the previous first quarter.
The company said that during the first quarter of 1997, it experienced greater than anticipated physical damage loss activity related to the 1996 accident year.

It said that after an in-depth review of loss reserves using further loss experience and segmented data on a state-by-state and product type basis, the company determined that reserves primarily related to automobile liability coverages needed to be strengthened. The 1997 first quarter operating loss was after a $42.0 million pretax increase to loss reserves.
